newsitem.title: USA: Zilog stock falls on earnings warning.
newsitem.headline: Zilog stock falls on earnings warning.

text.p: The stock of computer ciruits maker Zilog Inc. was off sharply Thursday after the company warned that its third-quarter profits will be substantially below the earnings of the second quarter.
In early trading, Zilog was down $9 at $14.875 on the New York Stock Exchange.

The Campbell, Calif.-based firm reported late Wednesday that its third-quarter earnings will be well below the 60 cents a share it reported in the second quarter. In last year's third quarter, Zilog earned 50 cents a share.
It also said that third-quarter sales will range between $64 million and $70 million, versus revenues of $85.5 million in the second quarter.
